stem.text: The power series \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n} \left(x - 1\right)^{n}}{4^{n} \left(\sqrt{n} + 6\right)} \) has radius of convergence \( 4 \). Determine whether the series converges or diverges at \( x = -3 \), naming the test used.

answer_key.label: At \( x = -3 \) the series diverges by limit comparison with \( \sum \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \), because \( p = \frac{1}{2} \le 1 \).

worked_solution.text: The ratio test gives convergence for \( \left|x - 1\right| < 4 \), so the left endpoint is \( x = -3 \).
At \( x = -3 \), \( \frac{\left(x - 1\right)^{n}}{4^{n}} = \left(\frac{-4}{4}\right)^{n} = (-1)^{n} \), so the series becomes \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{\sqrt{n} + 6} \).
The terms are positive and \( \lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{\sqrt{n}}{\sqrt{n} + 6} = 1 \), which is positive and finite, and the p-series with \( p = \frac{1}{2} \le 1 \) diverges.
At \( x = -3 \) the series diverges by limit comparison with \( \sum \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \), because \( p = \frac{1}{2} \le 1 \), so \( x = -3 \) does not belong to the interval of convergence.

options.label: At \( x = -3 \) the series converges by the alternating series test, because the terms \( \frac{(-1)^n}{\sqrt{n} + 6} \) alternate and shrink.
options.derivation: the factor (-1)^n produced by substituting the negative displacement -4 dropped, so the endpoint series was tested with the wrong sign pattern

options.label: At \( x = -3 \) the series diverges by limit comparison with \( \sum \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \), because \( p = \frac{1}{2} \le 1 \).
At \( x = -3 \) the series converges by the alternating series test, because the sizes \( \frac{1}{\sqrt{n} + 6} \) decrease to 0.
options.derivation: the alternating series test used on the endpoint series although its terms are all positive

options.label: At \( x = -3 \) the series diverges by direct comparison with \( \sum \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \), because \( \frac{1}{\sqrt{n} + 6} < \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} \).
options.derivation: the comparison inequality in the direction that cannot show divergence: terms smaller than those of a divergent series
